observedProblem: A long-idle browser tab attempted to use a closing IndexedDB connection for later private writes.
change: Reopen once when transaction creation raises InvalidStateError before admitting requests. Clear closed or superseded handles. Never retry an admitted transaction.
scope: Web private reads, writes, indexed pages, batches and atomic changes
limits: Does not recover deleted browser data or browser storage eviction.
The earlier unresolved draft discrepancy has not been attributed to this connection error.
Installed DTU acceptance is recorded separately from the source and synthetic browser checks.
